headline:
Celebrating 10 years of 
 RoboGrinder.
intro: Bringing Virginia Tech students together through competitive robotics since 2016.
mission: Turn classroom knowledge into hands-on experience.
missionContext: Students design parts, build circuits, write software, and test their work on the team’s robots. Members learn from each other as they take on projects beyond their classes. Students from every major are welcome.
teamImageAlt: RoboGrinder students celebrating at a robotics competition with their robots
joinCopy: Students from every major are welcome. Join a subteam to develop practical skills and help build our next fleet.
joinImageAlt: RoboGrinder member fine-tuning a competition robot
